_note: Chapter 25 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: The accident happened when a car skidded on the icy road.
ex.cn: 事故发生在一辆车于结冰路面上打滑的时候。

ex.en: She remains active in the university debate club.
ex.cn: 她在大学辩论社里依然很活跃。
ex.note: be active in 在…中很活跃；lead an active life 过着积极的生活

ex.en: It is not advisable to travel alone at night.
ex.cn: 夜里独自旅行并不明智。
ex.note: It is advisable to do sth. 做某事是明智的

ex.en: She showed me the album of photos from her trip.
ex.cn: 她给我看了她旅行时拍的那本相册。
ex.note: a photo album 相册；an album of 一张…专辑

ex.en: He sat among a group of noisy freshmen.
ex.cn: 他坐在一群吵闹的新生中间。
ex.note: among them 其中；among others 除了别的之外

ex.en: We do not have any time to waste this afternoon.
ex.cn: 今天下午我们没有一点时间可以浪费。
ex.note: any more 再也（不）；not … any more 不再

ex.en: The headmaster approved the plan for the new library.
ex.cn: 校长批准了建造新图书馆的计划。
ex.note: approve of 赞成；approve a plan 批准一个计划

ex.en: Aside from a few typos, the essay was well written.
ex.cn: 除了几个拼写错误，这篇文章写得很好。
ex.note: aside from 除…之外；set sth. aside 把某物放到一边

ex.en: The teacher asked the students to pay attention to the blackboard.
ex.cn: 老师让学生们注意黑板。
ex.note: pay attention to 注意；draw attention to 吸引注意力

ex.en: The baby in the next room was crying again.
ex.cn: 隔壁房间里的婴儿又哭了起来。
ex.note: a baby 一个婴儿；be a baby 幼稚

ex.en: Language can be a barrier, but it is never a wall.
ex.cn: 语言可能是一道障碍，但它绝不是一堵墙。
ex.note: break down a barrier 打破障碍；a language barrier 语言障碍

ex.en: A bee landed on the yellow flowers and stayed there.
ex.cn: 一只蜜蜂落在黄色的花上，赖在那儿不走。
ex.note: the bees and the honey 蜂与蜜；busy as a bee 像蜜蜂一样忙碌

ex.en: Taking the bus is better than walking in this rain.
ex.cn: 这种雨天坐公交车比走路强。
ex.note: better than 比…好；the better of 两者中较好的那个

ex.en: Reading aloud every morning bettered his spoken English.
ex.cn: 每天早上朗读改善了他的英语口语。

ex.en: The blind man learned to read by touching the letters.
ex.cn: 那位盲人靠触摸字母学会了阅读。
ex.note: be blind to 对…视而不见；blind sight 视力

ex.en: A thick fog blinded the drivers on the highway.
ex.cn: 一场浓雾让高速公路上的司机什么都看不见。
ex.note: be blinded by 被…致盲；blind sb. with light 用灯光晃瞎某人

ex.en: Both of my parents are teachers in the same school.
ex.cn: 我父母都在同一所学校教书。
ex.note: both of 两个都；both … and … …和…都

ex.en: She gave a brilliant answer to a very hard question.
ex.cn: 她对一个很难的问题给出了精彩的回答。
ex.note: brilliant idea 绝妙的主意；be brilliant at 擅长

ex.en: A butterfly rested on the rail for a whole minute.
ex.cn: 一只蝴蝶在栏杆上歇了整整一分钟。
ex.note: butterfly effect 蝴蝶效应

ex.en: He put the candy back in the jar without a sound.
ex.cn: 他一声不响地把糖放回了罐子里。
ex.note: a piece of candy 一块糖；candy floss 棉花糖

ex.en: The cat sat by the window and watched the birds.
ex.cn: 猫坐在窗边看着那些鸟。
ex.note: let the cat out of the bag 泄露秘密

ex.en: Learning a new language is a real challenge.
ex.cn: 学一门新语言是真正的挑战。
ex.note: pose a challenge to 对…构成挑战；take up the challenge 接受挑战

ex.en: The young engineer challenged the plan in front of the whole team.
ex.cn: 那位年轻工程师当着全队的面质疑了这个方案。
ex.note: challenge sb. to a duel 向某人挑战；challenge the authority 质疑权威

ex.en: Chew your food slowly, or you will get a stomachache.
ex.cn: 慢慢嚼，不然你会胃疼。
ex.note: chew on sth. 反复琢磨某事

ex.en: The museum traces five thousand years of civilization through its old collection.
ex.cn: 这座博物馆通过藏品追溯了五千年的文明。

ex.en: He joined the chess club in his first semester.
ex.cn: 他第一学期就加入了象棋社。
ex.note: the tennis club 网球俱乐部；club together 联合起来

ex.en: She tried to offer some comfort to the crying child.
ex.cn: 她试着安慰那个哭泣的孩子。
ex.note: give comfort to 给…安慰；be a comfort to 是…的安慰

ex.en: These old shoes comfort my feet better than any new pair.
ex.cn: 这双旧鞋比任何新鞋都更让我的脚舒服。
ex.note: comfort oneself 自慰；comfort zone 舒适区

ex.en: We received a complaint about the noise from the bar next door.
ex.cn: 我们收到了关于隔壁酒吧噪音的投诉。
ex.note: make a complaint 投诉；a complaint about 对…的抱怨

ex.en: The committee will conduct a survey among the students.
ex.cn: 委员会将在学生中开展一项调查。
ex.note: conduct a meeting/experiment 主持会议/进行实验

ex.en: His conduct in the office has always been beyond reproach.
ex.cn: 他在办公室里的操行一直无可指摘。
ex.note: good conduct 良好品行；conduct oneself 举止

ex.en: The course consists of ten lectures and a final paper.
ex.cn: 这门课由十次讲座和一篇期末论文组成。
ex.note: consist of 由…组成；consist in 在于

ex.en: The new policy caused a great deal of controversy.
ex.cn: 新政策引起了极大的争议。
ex.note: be controversial 有争议的；a controversy over 关于…的争论

ex.en: The children wore animal costumes for the school show.
ex.cn: 孩子们为学校汇演穿上了动物服装。
ex.note: in costume 穿着戏装

ex.en: The two young teachers created a reading club for the village.
ex.cn: 这两位年轻教师为村里创办了一个阅读俱乐部。
ex.note: create a chance 创造机会；create jobs 创造就业

ex.en: She drank two cups of tea before the lecture began.
ex.cn: 上课前她喝了两杯茶。
ex.note: a cup of tea 一杯茶；world cup 世界杯

ex.en: He dashed across the road to catch the last bus.
ex.cn: 他飞奔过马路去赶末班车。
ex.note: dash sb. hope 粉碎某人的希望

ex.en: There was a dash of salt in the soup.
ex.cn: 汤里撒了一点点盐。
ex.note: a dash of 一点点；dash off 匆匆离开

ex.en: They decorated the hall with paper lanterns for the festival.
ex.cn: 他们用纸灯笼装饰大厅，迎接节日。
ex.note: decorate with 用…装饰；be decorated with 装饰着

ex.en: It is no use to deny that the plan needs more work.
ex.cn: 否认这个计划还需要修改是没有用的。
ex.note: deny doing sth. 否认做某事；deny sb. sth. 拒绝给某人某物

ex.en: The detective asked a series of careful questions.
ex.cn: 侦探问了一连串谨慎的问题。
ex.note: a detective story 侦探小说；detectives 侦探部门

ex.en: She is a diligent student who has never missed a class.
ex.cn: 她是个勤奋的学生，从不缺课。
ex.note: be diligent in/at 在…方面勤勉

ex.en: He disguised his fear as confidence.
ex.cn: 他把恐惧伪装成自信。
ex.note: disguise oneself as 装扮成；disguise fear as confidence 把恐惧伪装成自信

ex.en: He wore a false beard as a simple disguise.
ex.cn: 他戴了一副假胡子作为简单的伪装。
ex.note: in disguise 伪装起来；a disguise for 伪装

ex.en: The fishing boats are tied along the old dock.
ex.cn: 渔船沿着旧码头系着。
ex.note: on the dock 在码头上；dock the ship 使船靠岸

ex.en: The ship docked just before sunrise.
ex.cn: 船在日出前靠了岸。
ex.note: dock at a port 在港口靠岸

ex.en: The heavy rain drained the water from the field.
ex.cn: 大雨把田里的水排干了。
ex.note: drain away 逐渐消失；drain sb. of 使某人失去

ex.en: The kitchen sink was blocked by a slow drain.
ex.cn: 厨房水槽的下水口排水不畅，被堵住了。
ex.note: a slow drain 排水缓慢的下水口

ex.en: She wiped the dust from the old photographs.
ex.cn: 她擦掉了旧照片上的灰尘。
ex.note: dust off 掸掉灰尘；gather dust 积灰

ex.en: He dusted the shelves and swept the floor.
ex.cn: 他给书架掸了灰，又扫了地。
ex.note: dust sth. with powder 在…上撒粉末

ex.en: The editorial in the paper praised the work of the volunteers.
ex.cn: 报纸的社论赞扬了志愿者的努力。
ex.note: an editorial in the paper 报纸上的社论

ex.en: The school decided to eliminate plastic bottles from the campus.
ex.cn: 学校决定让塑料瓶从校园里消失。
ex.note: eliminate the need for 消除对…的需要；be eliminated from 被排除

ex.en: Illiteracy is the enemy of a developing country.
ex.cn: 文盲是发展中国家的敌人。
ex.note: an enemy of … …的敌人；be enemies with 与…不和

ex.en: The new lab is equipped with the latest machines.
ex.cn: 新实验室配备了最新的机器。
ex.note: be equipped with 配备有；equip oneself with 自备

ex.en: The story is about the evil that greedy people do to each other.
ex.cn: 这个故事讲的是贪婪之人彼此施加的恶。

ex.en: The old house was said to be haunted by an evil spirit.
ex.cn: 据说那座老宅里住着一个恶灵。
ex.note: the evil eye 恶眼；evil spirit 恶灵

ex.en: The company plans to expand into three new cities.
ex.cn: 公司计划向三个新城市扩张。
ex.note: expand into 扩展到；expand on 详述

ex.en: This jacket is made of a soft wool fabric.
ex.cn: 这件夹克是用柔软的羊毛面料做的。
ex.note: the fabric of society 社会的结构

ex.en: The farmer works from sunrise to sunset in the fields.
ex.cn: 农民在田里从日出忙到日落。
ex.note: a farmer's market 农贸市场

ex.en: I had a feeling that something was wrong at home.
ex.cn: 我有一种感觉，家里好像出了什么事。
ex.note: a feeling of … 一种…的感觉；gut feeling 直觉

ex.en: He ran a finger along the edge of the knife.
ex.cn: 他用手指沿着刀刃抹了一下。
ex.note: finger print 指纹；keep one's fingers crossed 双手交叉祈好运

ex.en: After two years of practice she spoke fluent English.
ex.cn: 练了两年之后，她讲起了流利的英语。
ex.note: fluent in 精通；fluently 流畅地

ex.en: The university sent a formal letter of complaint to the company.
ex.cn: 大学向那家公司发了一封正式的抗议信。
ex.note: formal manners 正式的礼节；information 正式信息

ex.en: The people here are friendly to newcomers.
ex.cn: 这里的人对新来的人很友好。
ex.note: be friendly to 对…友好；a friendly match 友谊赛

ex.en: He filled a ten-gallon can of water at the farm.
ex.cn: 他在农场灌满了一个十加仑的桶。
ex.note: a gallon of 一加仑；gasoline gallon 汽油加仑

ex.en: He made a small gesture of apology with his hand.
ex.cn: 他用手做了一个小小的致歉动作。
ex.note: a gesture of … 一个…的动作；make no gesture 毫无表示

ex.en: She gestured toward the door, asking him to leave.
ex.cn: 她朝门口做了个手势，示意他离开。
ex.note: gesture to sb. to do 向某人手势示意其做某事

ex.en: A white goose walked across the courtyard.
ex.cn: 一只白鹅穿过院子。
ex.note: a wild goose 野鹅；silly goose 傻瓜

ex.en: The greedy boy took the largest piece of cake.
ex.cn: 那个贪吃的男孩拿走了最大的一块蛋糕。
ex.note: be greedy for 贪求；greedy for money 贪财

ex.en: The hail was so heavy that it broke two windows.
ex.cn: 冰雹大得砸碎了两扇窗户。
ex.note: a hail of criticism 一连串的批评

ex.en: It began to hail just as we left the house.
ex.cn: 我们刚离开家，冰雹就下起来了。
ex.note: hail a taxi 招手叫出租车；hail sb. 招呼某人

ex.en: She hated being told what to do.
ex.cn: 她讨厌被人指手画脚。
ex.note: hate doing sth. 讨厌做某事；hate sb./sth. 讨厌某人/某物

ex.en: Without her phone she felt helpless in the huge station.
ex.cn: 没了手机，她在那座巨大的车站里感到无助。
ex.note: helpless to do 无力做；feel helpless 感到无能为力

ex.en: The old bridge can hold heavy trucks.
ex.cn: 这座老桥能承受重型卡车。
ex.note: hold on 稍等；hold a meeting 举行会议

ex.en: He finally got a hold of the rope in the dark.
ex.cn: 黑暗中他终于抓住了那根绳子。
ex.note: get a hold of 抓住；at bay 控制住

ex.en: The whole household eats dinner at seven o'clock.
ex.cn: 全家人在七点吃晚饭。
ex.note: the household 家务；household chores 家务活

ex.en: She spends a great deal of time on household work.
ex.cn: 她花很多时间做家务。
ex.note: household goods 家居用品

ex.en: The old boat lay idle at the end of the dock.
ex.cn: 那条旧船闲置在码头尽头。
ex.note: lie idle 闲置；an idle machine 闲置的机器

ex.en: Instead of working, he idled around the office all afternoon.
ex.cn: 他没去干活，整个下午都在办公室里无所事事地转悠。
ex.note: idle away time 消磨时间；idle engine 空转的发动机

ex.en: Her speech impressed everyone in the hall.
ex.cn: 她的演讲让全场的人印象深刻。
ex.note: impress sb. 给某人留下深刻印象；be impressed with 对…印象深刻

ex.en: Mosquitoes can infect people with malaria.
ex.cn: 蚊子会把疟疾传染给人。
ex.note: be infected with 感染上；infect the computer 给电脑染毒

ex.en: The old professor was an inspiration to all his students.
ex.cn: 老教授是他所有学生的楷模。
ex.note: an inspiration to 对…的鼓舞；draw inspiration from 从…汲取灵感

ex.en: The city hosts an international film festival every year.
ex.cn: 这座城市每年举办一次国际电影节。
ex.note: an international student 国际学生；international trade 国际贸易

ex.en: He spent two years in jail for the robbery.
ex.cn: 他因这起抢劫在监狱里待了两年。
ex.note: go to jail 进监狱；the jail 监狱

ex.en: The thief was jailed for five years.
ex.cn: 那个小偷被判了五年牢。
ex.note: jail sb. for … 因…把某人关进监狱

ex.en: The train had just left the station when he arrived.
ex.cn: 他赶到时，火车刚刚驶离车站。
ex.note: just now 刚才；just a moment 稍等一下

ex.en: The judges reached a just decision after a long talk.
ex.cn: 经过长时间讨论，评委们作出了公正的裁决。
ex.note: a just decision 公正的裁决；just cause 正义的事业

ex.en: The members of the labor union met on Friday to talk about pay.
ex.cn: 工会的成员聚在一起讨论工资问题。
ex.note: labor union 工会；labor force 劳动力

ex.en: They lay the blanket on the grass and sat down.
ex.cn: 他们把毯子铺在草地上，坐了下来。
ex.note: lay the table 摆餐具；lay an egg 下蛋

ex.en: The film had less action but more music than the first one.
ex.cn: 这部电影的动作比第一部少，音乐却更多。
ex.note: no less than 不少于；less and more 渐渐

ex.en: Add a little liquid to the flour and mix it well.
ex.cn: 往面粉里加一点液体，然后拌匀。
ex.note: liquid medicine 液体药；liquid assets 流动资产

ex.en: The doctor asked him to stay on a liquid diet for three days.
ex.cn: 医生让他连续三天只吃流质食物。
ex.note: a liquid diet 流质饮食；liquid measure 液体量具

ex.en: They prayed to the Lord together before dinner.
ex.cn: 晚饭前他们一起向上帝祷告。
ex.note: the Lord 上帝；house and lord 庄园与主人

ex.en: The package arrived by mail on Tuesday.
ex.cn: 包裹在星期二通过邮寄到了。
ex.note: by mail 邮寄；the mail 邮件

ex.en: She mailed the letter to her old address.
ex.cn: 她把信寄到了从前的地址。
ex.note: mail a letter 寄信；mail order 邮购

ex.en: The little town has a marvelous view of the sea.
ex.cn: 这座小镇有一幅美妙的海上景色。
ex.note: a marvelous view 美妙的景色

ex.en: He needed medical attention after the fall.
ex.cn: 摔倒之后，他需要接受治疗。
ex.note: medical care 医疗照顾；medical history 病史

ex.en: We walked three miles before the rain began.
ex.cn: 雨下起来之前，我们走了三英里。
ex.note: a mile away 一英里之外；mileage 里程

ex.en: He built a small model of the old stone bridge.
ex.cn: 他做了一个石桥的小模型。
ex.note: a model of … …的模型；on the model of 按照…

ex.en: The young student modeled his answer on his teacher's.
ex.cn: 那个年轻学生仿照老师的答案来作答。
ex.note: model A on B 以 B 为范本模仿 A

ex.en: He rode his motorcycle to the office every morning.
ex.cn: 他每天早上骑摩托车去办公室。
ex.note: ride a motorcycle 骑摩托车

ex.en: The path through the woods was narrow and steep.
ex.cn: 穿过林间的小路又窄又陡。
ex.note: narrow escape 险胜；a narrow victory 勉强的胜利

ex.en: The gap between the two teams narrowed in the second half.
ex.cn: 下半场，两队之间的差距缩小了。
ex.note: narrow the gap 缩小差距；narrow down 缩小范围

ex.en: A bird built a nest in the old apple tree.
ex.cn: 一只鸟在老苹果树上筑了个巢。
ex.note: a nest of 一窝；empty the nest 空巢

ex.en: The swallows nested under the roof of the barn.
ex.cn: 燕子们在谷仓的屋顶下筑了巢。
ex.note: nestle 依偎；make a nest 筑巢

ex.en: His temperature is back to normal now.
ex.cn: 他的体温现在恢复正常了。
ex.note: back to normal 恢复正常；normal life 平常的生活

ex.en: I felt a real obligation to help them.
ex.cn: 我感到帮助他们是义不容辞的。
ex.note: an obligation to do 有义务做；under an obligation 受到责任约束

ex.en: My old bicycle still runs well after all these years.
ex.cn: 过了这么多年，我那辆旧自行车还很耐用。
ex.note: an old man 一位老人；the old days 从前

ex.en: It was an ordinary day, and nothing special happened.
ex.cn: 那是很普通的一天，什么特别的事也没发生。
ex.note: ordinary clothes 普通的衣服；an ordinary person 普通人

ex.en: He put on his overcoat and walked out into the snow.
ex.cn: 他穿上大衣，走进了雪里。
ex.note: wear an overcoat 穿大衣

ex.en: A panel of experts reviewed the paper at the conference.
ex.cn: 一个专家组在会上评审了这篇论文。
ex.note: a panel of judges 评审团；control panel 控制面板

ex.en: She patted the dog gently on the head.
ex.cn: 她轻轻拍了拍狗的头。
ex.note: pat sb. on the back 拍某人的背；a pat on the back 鼓励

ex.en: A large percentage of the students walk to school.
ex.cn: 很大一部分学生走路上学。
ex.note: a high percentage 很高的百分比；percentage points 百分点

ex.en: The physician said the illness was not serious.
ex.cn: 医生说这个病并不严重。
ex.note: a consulting physician 会诊医生

ex.en: The bowl is made of hard white plastic.
ex.cn: 这只碗是白色硬塑料做的。
ex.note: plastic money 塑料货币；plastic surgery 整形手术

ex.en: Please keep plastic bags away from small children.
ex.cn: 请把塑料袋放在幼儿够不到的地方。
ex.note: plastic waste 塑料垃圾；a plastic cup 塑料杯

ex.en: A young politician spoke to the crowd in the square.
ex.cn: 一位年轻政客在广场上对人群讲话。
ex.note: a local politician 地方政客；politician 政治家

ex.en: The postman brings the letters twice a week.
ex.cn: 邮递员每周送两次信。
ex.note: the local postman 当地的邮递员

ex.en: The presence of the doctor calmed the patient.
ex.cn: 医生的在场让病人安心了。
ex.note: in the presence of 在…面前；a strong presence 强大的影响力

ex.en: It is probable that the train will be late again.
ex.cn: 火车很可能会再次晚点。
ex.note: probable cause 可能的原因；probably 可能

ex.en: She proposed a new plan for the trip.
ex.cn: 她为这次旅行提出了一个新计划。
ex.note: propose a plan 提出计划；propose to sb. 向某人求婚

ex.en: She bought a purple dress for the party.
ex.cn: 她为聚会买了一条紫色的裙子。
ex.note: purple light 紫光；dark purple 深紫

ex.en: The old railroad runs along the edge of the town.
ex.cn: 那条旧铁路沿着小镇边缘铺过。
ex.note: railroad station 火车站；by railroad 乘火车

ex.en: I really enjoyed the concert last night.
ex.cn: 昨晚的音乐会我真的很喜欢。
ex.note: really? 真的吗？；not really 不见得

ex.en: The government plans to reform the tax system.
ex.cn: 政府计划改革税收制度。
ex.note: reform and opening 改革开放；call for reform 呼吁改革

ex.en: Her religious faith helped her through the hard years.
ex.cn: 她的宗教信仰帮助她度过了艰难的岁月。
ex.note: religious belief 宗教信仰；religious freedom 宗教自由

ex.en: She spent two years on research into old bridges.
ex.cn: 她花了两年时间研究古老的桥梁。
ex.note: do research into 研究；researcher 研究人员

ex.en: He returned the book to the library on Monday.
ex.cn: 他星期一把书还给了图书馆。
ex.note: return to 回到；return a call 回电话

ex.en: The company offered a good return on its investments.
ex.cn: 公司的投资获得了不错的回报。
ex.note: a good return 丰厚的回报；in return 作为回报

ex.en: He skipped a flat rock across the pond.
ex.cn: 他打了一颗扁平的石头，跳过池塘。
ex.note: rock music 摇滚乐；a rock in the sand 沙中磐石

ex.en: The old boat rocked gently in the harbour.
ex.cn: 那条旧船在港湾里轻轻摇晃。
ex.note: rock the boat 破坏和谐；rock sth. to its foundation 彻底动摇

ex.en: There was a sudden rush for the doors after the whistle.
ex.cn: 哨声一响，人群突然朝门口涌去。
ex.note: a rush for … 涌向…；rush hours 高峰时段

ex.en: He put all his savings into a small shop.
ex.cn: 他把全部积蓄投进了一家小店。
ex.note: a savings account 储蓄账户；savings and investments 储蓄与投资

ex.en: One loose screw was enough to break the machine.
ex.cn: 一颗松动的螺丝就足以弄坏这台机器。
ex.note: a screw loose 螺丝松动；turn the screw 施压

ex.en: He screwed the lid back onto the glass jar.
ex.cn: 他把盖子重新拧回了玻璃罐上。
ex.note: screw sth. on 把某物拧上；screw up 搞砸

ex.en: Senior students often help the first-years at the start of term.
ex.cn: 高年级学生常在开学时帮助新生。
ex.note: senior citizens 老年人；senior high 高中

ex.en: The two seniors asked the teacher for advice.
ex.cn: 那两个高年级学生向老师请教。
ex.note: a senior among them 他们中间的年长者

ex.en: What a shame that you missed the show last night!
ex.cn: 真可惜，你错过了昨晚的演出！
ex.note: What a shame! 真可惜！；feel shame 感到羞愧

ex.en: The shame of his failure silenced him completely.
ex.cn: 失败的羞惭让他彻底说不出话来。
ex.note: shame sb. into doing 使某人羞愧得不得不做

ex.en: The results show a clear improvement in her writing.
ex.cn: 结果显示她的写作有了明显的进步。
ex.note: show sb. sth. 给某人看某物；show off 炫耀

ex.en: The school put on a show for the parents.
ex.cn: 学校为家长上演了一场演出。
ex.note: a fashion show 时装秀；on show 在展出

ex.en: He has been single for three years now.
ex.cn: 他单身三年了。
ex.note: a single room 单人间；single-minded 一心一意的

ex.en: A single ticket to the city costs ten yuan.
ex.cn: 一张到市里的单程票要十元。
ex.note: a single ticket 单程票；not a single 一个也没有

ex.en: The wet rocks were too slippery to walk on.
ex.cn: 湿漉漉的岩石太滑了，没法走。
ex.note: a slippery slope 危险的路；slippery fish 狡猾的家伙

ex.en: The soldier stood guard at the gate all night.
ex.cn: 那名士兵在门口站了一夜岗。
ex.note: a veteran soldier 老兵；soldier on 继续干下去

ex.en: There is not much space for a big table in this room.
ex.cn: 这个房间里放一张大桌子不太够地方。
ex.note: space for 给…留出的空间；outer space 外太空

ex.en: He did it out of spite, not out of reason.
ex.cn: 他这么做是出于恶意，而不是出于理性。
ex.note: out of spite 出于恶意；spite sb. 故意刁难某人

ex.en: The villagers would starve without help from outside.
ex.cn: 没有外来的帮助，村里的人会挨饿。
ex.note: starve to death 饿死；be starved of 缺乏

ex.en: He stooped down to pick up the fallen coins.
ex.cn: 他弯腰捡起掉落的硬币。
ex.note: stoop to doing 屈尊做某事；stoop down 弯腰俯身

ex.en: She struggled to keep her voice steady.
ex.cn: 她努力让自己的声音保持平稳。
ex.note: struggle to do 努力做；struggle for 争取

ex.en: The sum of the two numbers is thirty.
ex.cn: 这两个数的和是三十。
ex.note: the sum of … …的总和；a large sum of 一大笔

ex.en: The teacher asked us to sum up the main points.
ex.cn: 老师让我们把要点总结一下。
ex.note: sum up 总结；sum up the costs 算出总费用

ex.en: The house stands in beautiful surroundings.
ex.cn: 这栋房子坐落于优美的环境之中。
ex.note: in the surroundings 在周围环境中

ex.en: A tailor measured him for a new suit.
ex.cn: 一位裁缝给他量了做新西装的身尺寸。
ex.note: a tailor-made suit 定做的西装

ex.en: The course is tailored to the needs of beginners.
ex.cn: 这门课程是为初学者的需要量身设计的。
ex.note: tailor sth. to 为…量身定制

ex.en: He lost his temper and slammed the door.
ex.cn: 他发了脾气，把门砰地关上。
ex.note: lose one's temper 发脾气；in a bad temper 心情恶劣

ex.en: The teacher asked them to wait outside the office.
ex.cn: 老师让他们在办公室外面等着。
ex.note: them 作宾语；of them 其中

ex.en: More than a thousand people came to the show.
ex.cn: 一千多人来看演出。
ex.note: a thousand 一千；thousands of 成千上万

ex.en: He was too tired to walk any further.
ex.cn: 他累得再也走不动了。
ex.note: be tired of 厌倦；tired out 累坏了

ex.en: The wind blew toward the open sea all night.
ex.cn: 风朝开阔的海上吹了一整夜。
ex.note: toward(s) 朝；向；toward(s) the end 接近尾声时

ex.en: The treatment lasted six weeks and cost very little.
ex.cn: 治疗持续了六个星期，费用也很低。
ex.note: medical treatment 医疗；special treatment 特殊对待

ex.en: We roasted a turkey for the family dinner.
ex.cn: 我们为家庭晚餐烤了一只火鸡。
ex.note: a whole turkey 一整只火鸡

ex.en: Her unexpected answer silenced the whole room.
ex.cn: 她出人意料的回答让全场安静下来。
ex.note: quite unexpected 相当意外；unexpectedly 出乎意料地

ex.en: She used to work at a small bookshop near the station.
ex.cn: 她以前在车站附近的一家小书店工作。
ex.note: used to do 过去常常做；be used to doing 习惯于做

ex.en: This version of the story is much shorter.
ex.cn: 这个版本的故事短得多。
ex.note: the latest version 最新版本；in an English version 以英文版

ex.en: Sleep is vital to good health.
ex.cn: 睡眠对健康至关重要。
ex.note: be vital to 对…至关重要；vital signs 生命体征

ex.en: We watched the storm from the kitchen window.
ex.cn: 我们从厨房的窗口看着暴风雨。
ex.note: watch sb. do 观看某人做；watch over 看守

ex.en: He looked at his watch and missed the last bus.
ex.cn: 他看了看手表，错过了末班车。
ex.note: on one's watch 在某人值班时；keep watch 守望

ex.en: The city provides welfare for families in need.
ex.cn: 市政府为有需要的家庭提供福利。
ex.note: social welfare 社会福利；welfare state 福利国家

ex.en: The river is wide and slow at this point.
ex.cn: 河到这里又宽又缓。
ex.note: wide awake 完全清醒；a wide range of 广泛的

ex.en: He opened the door wide and looked around the room.
ex.cn: 他把门开得大大的，环顾了一下房间。
ex.note: wide open 大开着；widely 广泛地

ex.en: They built a small table from old pieces of wood.
ex.cn: 他们用几块旧木头做了一张小桌子。
ex.note: out of the woods 脱离困境；a wood 木头

ex.en: He yawned and stretched by the open window.
ex.cn: 他在开着的窗边打了个哈欠，伸了个懒腰。
ex.note: yawn widely 打个大哈欠；a yawning gap 巨大的差距
